players.product: 6-inch GaAs (III-V) compound foundry: 400G/800G VCSELs for optical datacom (photodiodes in development), alongside InGaP HBT / pHEMT RF processes

quarterly_data.signal: Parent Sino-American Silicon's Q2 2026 deck on affiliate AWSC: demand for optical communication components continues to grow, driven by AI data centers and higher-speed data transmission, with LDs (laser diodes) and PDs (photo diodes) as key components; AWSC has initiated cooperation with multiple international customers, and the related products have entered the customer sampling and qualification stage.
